import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
def report_date(value):
    config = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name("settings.json").read_text())
    provider = importlib.import_module(config["date_provider"])
    return getattr(provider, config["date_method"])(value)

# Public title API

Supported routes are /v1/title and /v2/title. The balance route is unrelated.

When deprecating a route, add its replacement route and ISO cutoff date to deprecations.json as replacement and sunset. request() exposes that metadata in headers without changing the supported response body.
